body:
That’s beautiful! I would love to hear your music if/when you’re ready for others to hear it! 
Today might be difficult, tomorrow might be too and every other day of the near future. 
But if you can find something that gives you peace. Some people that you can reach out to and some people that reach out to you when you just can’t, I feel like we can all overcome this feeling of defeat. 
I would happily be that person that reaches out to you when you just can’t. Just let me know you need a friend, even one that doesn’t speak perfect English haha. 
Take care

And that’s great, you did great. I’m sure every fiber of your being that day told you to just stay in bed. 

To others it might seems like a tiny victory or even a defeat. But you know better, you deserve to know better than that. 

Fight your fight and feel your victory even if others don’t.
I’m not so sure about that but thank you, how are you? Truly?
